author: worker_1
belief: Hoorae, Issa Rae's production company, features content created by people of color. Evidence includes: 1) Hoorae has a talent management division called ColorCreative specifically for women and people of color. 2) Hoorae produced 'A Black Lady Sketch Show' (all-Black female cast), 'Rap Sh!t' (about two female MCs), and 'Sweet Life: Los Angeles' (showcasing Black excellence). 3) Hoorae has an initiative called Ensemble aimed at supporting Black and brown creators. 4) Issa Rae's stated mission through Hoorae is to champion Black artists and creators of color.

author: worker_1
belief: Issa Rae has had significant success: Her HBO show 'Insecure' (2016-2021) received critical acclaim, was named one of the top 10 TV programs of 2017 by the American Film Institute, ranked among the greatest TV series of the 21st century by major publications, and won a Peabody Award. She received multiple Golden Globe and Emmy nominations. Her films 'The Photograph' and 'The Lovebirds' were box office successes.

author: worker_2
belief: Hoorae has had significant success: In March 2021, Hoorae signed a five-year, $40 million deal with WarnerMedia (HBO, HBO Max, Warner Bros.) for exclusive TV rights and first-look film arrangements. Hoorae has produced multiple successful shows including Insecure (Peabody Award winner, multiple Emmy nominations), A Black Lady Sketch Show (Emmy-nominated), Rap Sh!t, and others. The company has expanded to include ColorCreative talent management and Raedio audio division.
